items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism f : Y -> X of algebraic spaces is quasi-affine if and only if the canonical factorization Y -> Spec_X(f_*O_Y) is an open immersion (source lines 4270-4278). The proof performs a three-step reduction to the scheme case: quasi-affineness may be checked after a surjective base change U -> X with U a scheme, the pushforward of O_Y restricts to the pushforward along the base change, and the formation of the relative spectrum commutes with base change; once X is a scheme, both conditions force Y to be a scheme, and the statement becomes the scheme case.
